rules.why: avoid flub; leave room for bass
HM-2 character is a broad mid push (500 Hz–2 kHz plateau), not a scoop
mids not honky relative to the saw band
metric target from tone_targets.json (no tolerance given)
noise-like fizz above 5 kHz sounds grainy/cheap; real amp+cab guitar is smooth there

buzz.def: spectral flatness (geometric/arithmetic mean of power) over 1–3 kHz on active frames

loudnessRangeLU.def: EBU R128 LRA-style short-term loudness range

gapNoiseDb.def: RMS in gate-closed gaps (bottom 5% frames) relative to active RMS

diNoiseFloorDb.note: 5th-percentile 50 ms DI frame level (dBFS); use to calibrate gate thresholds

lowTightnessMs.def: median time for 80–160 Hz band energy to fall 20 dB after detected onsets
